svg.title: Base Case: $535,000 Earned Revenue to $227,375 Owner Profit
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-earned-revenue-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Base Case: $535,000 Earned Revenue to $227,375 Owner Profit; subtitle: Six bars reconcile recognized gross operator revenue, four expense deductions, and the exact 42.5% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The opening and closing bars are totals; the four intervening bars are signed deductions, not cumulative balances. Expense categories are an illustrative allocation of the canonical $307,625 total costs. Recognized gross revenue excludes escrow principal and amounts collected for other principals. Operator EMD JV allocations are already limited to the earned contractual operator share; no additional retained-share multiplier is supplied or applied.; caption: $535,000 − $107,000 − $80,250 − $64,200 − $56,175 = $227,375; $227,375 ÷ $535,000 = 42.5%. Conservative: $120,000 × 30% = $36,000 with 1 FT + 2 C. Scaled: $950,000 × 55% = $522,500 with 2 FT + 3 C. Principal-versus-agent presentation follows the applicable ASC 606 assessment, not the size of the escrow wire.; stages: label: Recognized gross operator revenue; value: $535,000 earned fees and operator JV allocations.; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Opening total: $375,000 transactional funding fees, $120,000 earned operator EMD JV allocations, and $40,000 separate origination fees. Do not add property sale prices, escrow principal, unearned points, or another participant's beneficial share.; label: Capital access and carrying costs; value: Subtract $107,000 for documented funding-capital expenses.; numeric value: -107000.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 20% of revenue leaves $428,000. Includes contracted facility interest, commitment charges, and deployment carry; excludes repayment of borrowed principal and distributions already excluded from recognized operator revenue.; label: Contractor delivery and specialist costs; value: Subtract $80,250 for the three-person operating pod.; numeric value: -80250.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 15% of revenue leaves $347,750. Covers the two contractors and directly attributable outside specialist work. The owner's residual profit is not deducted again as a distribution.; label: Recurring operating overhead; value: Subtract $64,200, equivalent to $5,350 monthly overhead.; numeric value: -64200.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 12% of revenue leaves $283,550. Covers software, insurance, bookkeeping, secure communications, and recurring operating services. $5,350 falls within the canonical $2,000–$12,000 monthly operating-expense range.; label: Loss allowance and transaction friction; value: Subtract $56,175 for modeled losses and closing friction.; numeric value: -56175.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 10.5% of revenue leaves $227,375. Models credit-loss expense, failed-file costs, wire charges, and unrecovered closing expenses. Moving cash into a reserve account alone is not an additional expense.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $227,375 residual profit at exactly 42.5% margin.; numeric value: 227375.0; detail: Closing total, not an additional positive movement: the Base-Case 1 FT + 2 C pod retains 42.5 cents per earned revenue dollar after the modeled costs. The figure is owner profit, not gross billings or deployed funding capacity.

text.title: Base Case: $535,000 Earned Revenue to $227,375 Owner Profit
text.tspan: Base Case: $535,000 Earned Revenue to $227,375 Owner

rect.title: label: Recognized gross operator revenue; value: $535,000 earned fees and operator JV allocations.; numeric value: 535000.0; detail: Opening total: $375,000 transactional funding fees, $120,000 earned operator EMD JV allocations, and $40,000 separate origination fees. Do not add property sale prices, escrow principal, unearned points, or another participant's beneficial share.

label: Capital access and carrying costs; value: Subtract $107,000 for documented funding-capital expenses.; numeric value: -107000.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 20% of revenue leaves $428,000. Includes contracted facility interest, commitment charges, and deployment carry; excludes repayment of borrowed principal and distributions already excluded from recognized operator revenue.

label: Contractor delivery and specialist costs; value: Subtract $80,250 for the three-person operating pod.; numeric value: -80250.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 15% of revenue leaves $347,750. Covers the two contractors and directly attributable outside specialist work. The owner's residual profit is not deducted again as a distribution.

label: Recurring operating overhead; value: Subtract $64,200, equivalent to $5,350 monthly overhead.; numeric value: -64200.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 12% of revenue leaves $283,550. Covers software, insurance, bookkeeping, secure communications, and recurring operating services. $5,350 falls within the canonical $2,000–$12,000 monthly operating-expense range.

label: Loss allowance and transaction friction; value: Subtract $56,175 for modeled losses and closing friction.; numeric value: -56175.0; detail: Illustrative deduction of 10.5% of revenue leaves $227,375. Models credit-loss expense, failed-file costs, wire charges, and unrecovered closing expenses. Moving cash into a reserve account alone is not an additional expense.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $227,375 residual profit at exactly 42.5% margin.; numeric value: 227375.0; detail: Closing total, not an additional positive movement: the Base-Case 1 FT + 2 C pod retains 42.5 cents per earned revenue dollar after the modeled costs. The figure is owner profit, not gross billings or deployed funding capacity.
